exercises.prompt: Kalimat mana yang paling specific dan contextual?
options: Furniture revenue in West fell 41% QoQ, the largest decline across category-region combinations.
Based on the analysis that has been conducted, it can be seen that revenue changed.
The business is doing badly because customers lost interest.
exercises.incorrect_feedback: Writing data perlu metric, scope, comparison, dan klaim yang proporsional.
exercises.success_feedback: Benar. Kalimat memimpin dengan evidence yang dapat diperiksa.

exercises.prompt: Tulis ulang “Revenue turun signifikan” agar memiliki metric, periode, dan angka yang dapat diperiksa.
exercises.reference_answer: Revenue turun 12,4 persen QoQ pada data yang dibandingkan.
